segments.name: Shopping Centers
segments.description: Grocery-anchored shopping centers in the Washington, DC/Baltimore area, leasing space to retail tenants for rent and expense reimbursements.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary strategy is to continue to diversify its assets through development of transit-oriented, residential mixed-use projects and expansion of and additions to its grocery-anchored Shopping Centers in the Washington, DC/Baltimore metropolitan area.

segments.name: Mixed-Use Properties
products: office, retail and multi-family residential uses
segments.description: Transit-oriented properties combining office, retail and multi-family residential uses, leasing space to office, retail and residential tenants.
segments.evidence: The properties have been aggregated into two reportable business segments: Shopping Centers and Mixed-Use Properties.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent and expense reimbursements for space, plus parking and lease termination fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Total property revenue includes most components of rental revenue, except straight-line rent and above and below market lease amortization, plus parking revenues and lease termination fee revenue.
